name: mimo-code
label: MiMo Code
description: Xiaomi's terminal coding agent for MiMo models, driven headless
tagline: Xiaomi's terminal coding agent, on a Xiaomi account sign-in, a MiMo API key or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Installed by Xiaomi's own script.

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not configured — sign in with a Xiaomi account (mimo providers login -p xiaomi), or set an API key (press e). A MiMo API key works with the prefilled base URL; create one at https://platform.xiaomimimo.com.

env_config.name: LLM_API_KEY
env_config.description: API key — leave blank to run on the Xiaomi account signed in to MiMo Code. Otherwise a MiMo API key from https://platform.xiaomimimo.com, a MiMo Token Plan key (with its Token Plan base URL), or a key for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint set below.

env_config.name: LLM_BASE_URL
env_config.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for the API key above, prefilled with MiMo's API. MiMo Token Plan: https://token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com/v1 (Europe: token-plan-ams, Singapore: token-plan-sgp). Any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint works too. Not used with a Xiaomi account sign-in.

env_config.name: LLM_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id, e.g. mimo-v2.6-pro. Optional on MiMo's API and with a Xiaomi sign-in, where a blank one runs the first pro model MiMo lists; required for any other endpoint. The list is loaded from the endpoint.
